title: A test pins the settings.json cloud-pull entry to start and resume only, never compact
why: Lane compact-resume-runs-start (#2481), via the coordinator 20:10 CST Nov 9: no test pins the settings.json cloud-pull SessionStart entry (`startup|resume`, around line 175) to exclude compact. A later edit that adds compact there, as #2481 did for session_start.sh, would run the pull and install mid-task with the tests still green.
note: Fix: one red case in the settings-matcher tests (lint/test_settings_matcher.py is the likely home) that fails when the cloud-pull entry matches compact. Related: compact-resume-runs-start. Filed 20:09 CST Nov 9.
